title: Certify multiple-negative Q8 minima with dirty spectators
body:
## Summary

```text
positive paid labels i,j; every input dirty; complete formal equality
three roles, two negatives + one positive: 7 calls, all 24 endpoints
three roles, three negatives:             9 calls, all 8 endpoints
four roles, two negatives + one positive: 7 calls, all 96 endpoints
four roles, two negatives + two restored: 6 calls, all 24 endpoints
```

Certify the direct bill on these 152 endpoints by exact finite meet-in-the-middle exclusion and trace parity. This closes a bounded part of PR3460's multiple-negative handoff and extends PR2318's negative pairs through two dirty spectators. Arbitrary workspace, nonuniform prices, physical supplier and kappa remain open. Credit Aaron Wang/PR2318, ywz65/PR2587, Nick Petalas/PR3450/3460 and the retained register-model lineage.

Only `research/q8-multiple-negative-census/` changes. Source pins, scope, proof of the finite coverage reduction and exact replay are in its README, RESULT, TASK and manifests. The [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19010131) records the scope. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the all-role one-negative theorem gives only one two-call excess for a nonempty negative set; the prior complete pair table fixes two roles.
  **After:** exhaustive searches exclude every shorter parity-compatible word in ten role-bound symmetry orbits, with explicit attaining words for all 152 labelled endpoints.
- The independent Hamilton/full-convolution implementation regenerates every stored ball, checks 64 group products and 8,502 probe matrices, and repeats the smaller meet queries. All 1,056 deleted-call controls fail. The two largest full membership streams use the native implementation; independent duplicate streams are unclaimed.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized actual native faults and CLI controls, strict C++ diagnostics and scoped Ruff checks pass. All twelve committed package/input files pass the byte/source-history check. Both actual committed Git-free commands pass; all thirteen payload/transport files retain their bytes, modes and inodes. Hosted completion is unclaimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/q8-multiple-negative-census
```

Requires a C++20 `clang++` or `g++`; set TMPDIR to an owned external directory. Frozen inputs and selected frontier are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one opt-in finite research package. No shared tool or predecessor changes. The result is a scoped negative certificate; no native supplier, new kappa or all-size multiplication theorem is asserted.
